tools.name: get_mortgage_quote
tools.description: Real CapCenter conventional fixed-rate quotes (30, 20 and 15-year) for a purchase, refinance or cash-out refinance scenario in a county CapCenter serves: rate, APR, points, monthly principal and interest, ZERO Closing Costs, and a required_disclosure for any rate, APR or payment. Inputs are rounded before pricing. Answers in Spanish with language=es (cotización hipotecaria). Also returns an apply link.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are quoted.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages (/mortgage-rates/{state}/{slug}), e.g. henrico-county or richmond.

value.description: Home value (the purchase price on a purchase), whole dollars.

down.description: Purchase only: down payment in whole dollars, 3–90% of value. If omitted, 20% down is assumed and the response sets down_payment_assumed.

balance.description: Refinance and cash-out only (required): the mortgage balance being replaced, whole dollars.

cashOut.description: Cash-out only (required): cash out, whole dollars.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_todays_rates
tools.description: Today's published CapCenter mortgage rate tables for a county (the same tables its rates page shows): Conventional, Veteran (VA) and FHA 30- and 15-year fixed, each row with rate, APR, points and ZERO Closing Costs, plus the scenario they were priced for, the as-of time, the source page and the required disclosures. Answers in Spanish with language=es (tasas hipotecarias de hoy).

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

purpose.description: purchase (default) or refinance: which rates page view.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_savings_estimate
tools.description: Estimate what a client saves with CapCenter when buying, selling, selling and buying, or refinancing in a county CapCenter serves: the itemized typical-lender closing costs vs CapCenter (ZERO Closing Costs), the Realty Purchase Credit (0.5% of the price, where CapCenter Realty operates), the 1% Listing Fee (1.5% sell-only, $3,000 minimum, vs 3%), and a note on insurance (CapCenter publishes no insurance savings figure). Uses the site’s own math. Answers in Spanish with language=es (ahorros).

goal.description: buy (buy a home with a CapCenter mortgage and agent), sell, sell-and-buy, or refinance.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

price.description: buy and sell-and-buy (required): purchase price of the home being bought, whole dollars.

down.description: buy and sell-and-buy: down payment, whole dollars (3–90% of the price). If omitted, 20% down is assumed and the response sets down_payment_assumed.

sale_price.description: sell and sell-and-buy (required): expected sale price of the home being sold, whole dollars.

balance.description: refinance (required): current mortgage balance, whole dollars.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: explain_loan_options
tools.description: Answers questions about CapCenter's loan programs, ZERO Closing Costs (what it covers and what is still paid), eligibility basics (620 minimum credit score, DTI up to 50%), refinance and home equity options, the states CapCenter is licensed in and its NMLS ID. Every answer is CapCenter's published FAQ text, verbatim, with its source URL. With language=es, a Spanish courtesy translation is included beside the English (opciones de préstamo, requisitos).

topic.description: Which answers to return: all (default), zero-closing-costs, programs, eligibility (credit score, DTI), refinance, home-equity or licensing (states, NMLS).

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_next_step_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the next step on capcenter.com: apply for a mortgage (optionally prefilled with purpose, home value, balance and county), meet a CapCenter real estate agent, or request an insurance quote. Links only; personal details are entered by the person on capcenter.com. Spanish labels with language=es (solicitar, siguiente paso).

action.description: apply (loan application), meet-agent (request a CapCenter REALTOR®) or insurance-quote.

purpose.description: apply only, optional prefill: purchase, refinance or cash-out.

value.description: apply only, optional prefill: home value (purchase price on a purchase), whole dollars.

balance.description: apply only, optional prefill (refinance and cash-out): current mortgage balance, whole dollars.

state.description: apply only, optional prefill: two-letter state code.

county.description: apply only, optional prefill: rates-page location slug, e.g. henrico-county.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_affordability_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the most home a person could finance with CapCenter from gross income, monthly debts, cash for the down payment, their estimated monthly taxes/insurance/HOA, credit band and county: a 50% maximum debt-to-income ratio, at 80% loan-to-value or less, then a REAL CapCenter quote (rate, APR, payment and required disclosure) for the estimated price. An estimate, not a pre-approval. Answers in Spanish with language=es (cuánto puedo pagar).

income.description: Gross annual household income, whole dollars.

monthly_debts.description: Monthly debt payments (car, student loans, minimum card payments), whole dollars. Not rent.

down_payment.description: Cash available for the down payment, whole dollars.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

taxes_insurance.description: Required: estimated monthly property taxes, homeowners insurance and HOA dues for the kind of home being considered, whole dollars (the person’s figures or a listing’s). CapCenter has no county tax data to estimate them from.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_loan_limits
tools.description: The 2026 conforming (FHFA, Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) and FHA (HUD) loan limits for 1–4 unit homes in a county CapCenter serves, with the official sources. A loan above the conforming limit is a Jumbo loan. Answers in Spanish with language=es (límites de préstamo).

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county or richmond.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_reviews_and_ratings
tools.description: CapCenter's public ratings as shown on capcenter.com (Zillow 5.0 with 800+ reviews, Google 4.8 with 600+ reviews, BBB A+), each with its source link and as-of date, plus a few client quotes CapCenter publishes (BestCompany reviews, first name and last initial). Answers in Spanish with language=es (opiniones, calificaciones).

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: compare_refinance_options
tools.description: Compare keeping a current mortgage with a CapCenter rate-and-term refinance, a cash-out refinance and a home equity loan, using real CapCenter pricing: new monthly principal and interest, the change, cost to close (ZERO Closing Costs; points shown), break-even months, total interest and estimated benefit over the years the client plans to stay. Flags when keeping the current loan is better. An estimate, not a loan offer. Answers in Spanish with language=es (refinanciamiento).

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

current_rate.description: Current mortgage interest rate, percent, e.g. 7.25.

payment.description: Current monthly principal and interest payment only (no taxes, insurance or escrow), whole dollars; computed from rate, balance and years left if omitted.

years_left.description: Years left on the current loan.

cash_wanted.description: Cash wanted from home equity, whole dollars (0 or omitted = none).

years_staying.description: Years the client expects to keep the home and loan.

propertyType.description: sfr (default, single-family home), condo or townhouse.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Returns links to book time with CapCenter: a loan consultation (scheduling page and contact page), a real estate agent to buy or sell, or an insurance quote. Links only; personal details are entered by the person on capcenter.com. Answers in Spanish with language=es (consulta, cita).

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: search_homes_for_sale
tools.description: Homes for sale on capcenter.com in a city, county or ZIP code in a state CapCenter is licensed in, filtered by price, bedrooms, bathrooms and home type (up to 10). Returns the public listing facts (price, beds, baths, square feet, city, ZIP, photo, status), the capcenter.com listing link, the MLS attribution to show with each listing, a quote link with the price filled in and a link to meet a CapCenter Realty agent. Answers in Spanish with language=es (viviendas en venta).

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

city.description: City name, e.g. Richmond or Glen Allen. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

county.description: County name, e.g. Henrico or Chesterfield County. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

property_type.description: house, townhouse, condo, manufactured or land.

limit.description: How many listings to return, 1 to 10 (default 5).

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

tools.name: get_home_value_estimate
tools.description: CapCenter’s automated home value estimate (low, median and high) for an address or a capcenter.com listing URL in a state CapCenter is licensed in, with its as-of date and disclaimer (an estimate, not an appraisal), and links to the three next steps in order: cash out and stay, buy the next home, sell. Answers in Spanish with language=es (valor de la vivienda).

address.description: The home’s street address with city, state and ZIP, e.g. "123 Main St, Richmond, VA 23220". Give address or listing_url.

listing_url.description: A capcenter.com listing URL, https://www.capcenter.com/homes/real-estate/{listing}. Give address or listing_url.

mortgage_balance.description: Optional: the current mortgage balance, whole dollars. Only fills in the cash-out link (rounded to $10,000); never stored.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.
